inputs.text: Rising energy costs and canceled flights are hitting ordinary families, and leaders owe the public a clear account of what this war is meant to achieve and what risks they are asking people to bear. Support for Israel’s defense matters, but it is not a blank check for an open-ended conflict. National security requires resolve; it also requires competent leadership, defined aims, and accountability—not drifting into a war with no credible path to success.
